summary: First-party executable Provider plugin for MiniMax text, video, speech, and music generation.
context_hints: The Provider id is clash.minimax; keep its declaration in providers/minimax.json
Plugin code performs native upstream HTTP and uses only the Host-selected account state exposed through context.store
Every MiniMax H3 reference is uploaded through /v1/files/upload before submission; submitted references use mm_file:// handles only
The source gate checks every ResolvedReference variant: media accepts bytes/provider-url only and explicitly rejects executor-url Host capabilities and Documents before any Provider request.

subdirectories.providers: MiniMax Provider declaration and account authentication form.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, native MiniMax adapter, executor, and protocol tests.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations.
key_files.providers/minimax.json: Provider metadata, executor link, and regional API-key configuration.
key_files.src/minimax-adapter.ts: Node plugin account/reference glue consuming portable @clash/shared-runtime/minimax-executor submit/poll primitives.
